Title: User Story (10) "As an unauthorized user, I want to sign in with an email and password so that I am able to save my chat history, and pick up where I left off."
User Story (5) "As a user, I want to upload conversation logs from the AI models I already use, so that I don’t have to set up and learn a new model to utilize the reflection software."
User Story (19) "As a user, I want to have a reflection agent ask me questions about my AI use so that I am prompted to think about and improve how I use AI over time."
User Story (14) "As an authorized user, I want to upload files and documents from CollaborAITE's platform for the AI to look at during conversations with the user."
User Story (4) "As an authorized user, I want to view data about my ability to catch AI errors over time so that I can gauge if I’m actually improving."

User Story (12) "As an authorized user, I want to get a detailed summary of my AI usage of the session and overall after I am done chatting with the AI so that I can see my usage patterns and habits."
User Story (9) "As a user, I want the agent to answer basic questions about how to use the software’s UI and menus so I can use the software without having to consult external documentation."
User Story (16) "As an authorized user, I want to be able to set options for what the AI agent can access from me so that I can keep sensitive information private."
User Story (7) "As an authorized user, I want to give feedback to the reflection agent so that over time it will align more with my needs."
User Story (2) "As an authorized user, I want to access summaries of my previous reflection sessions so that I can quickly review them to ensure I’m applying what I discovered in them."

User Story (17) "As a learner, I want a quick downloadable review of what the agent and I talked about so that I can look back and not have to read through the entire chat to figure out what the chat was about."

User Story (6) "As an authorized user, I want any sensitive personal information automatically removed from the conversations I upload, so that I can partake in the reflection process without worrying about privacy issues."

User Story (13) "As a learner, I want integrated agent responses with citations to professional documents and curated knowledge based on how to use AI for effective learning and use outside and inside of the chatroom."
User Story (15) "As an authorized user, I want to change settings for the AI’s intensity so that I can configure the AI to be more involved in conversations or leave it more open-ended."
User Story (3) "As a user, I want to make the reflection agent give practice responses with intentional errors, so that I can practice catching them."
User Story (11) "As an authorized user, I want to view my personal AI chat history on my account so that I am able to look back on previous chats I have had with the reflection agent."
User Story (8) "As an authorized user, I want to receive configurable reminders to do reflection, so that I consistently go through the process and don’t forget about it because of other work."

User Story (18) "As a learner, I want to be able to highlight main ideas of the conversation with the agent in a review so that I can quickly know what a conversation was about based on the main points."
User Story (1) "As an unauthorized user, I want to access the system as a guest so I can get a quick analysis of my AI usage without worrying about data retention."
